raw_segments.text: Then my own thoughts worried me.
What crime was this, that lived incarnate in this sequestered mansion, and could neither
be expelled nor subdued by the owner?
What mystery, that broke out now in fire and now in blood at the deadest hours of night?
What creature was it that, masked in an ordinary woman's face and shape, uttered the voice,
now of a mocking demon and a gnaw of a carrion-seeking bird of prey?
